title: Travel Density & Protein Reference
strategy: The tiers and the 35-40g-per-meal protein floor don't change on the road. At home the system is a shopping list, traveling it's an ordering script.
ordering_script: Could I get the [protein] grilled/roasted/broiled, dry, no butter finish, sauce on the side?
Can I swap the [potato/rice/fries] for a double order of vegetables, steamed or grilled, no oil?
defaults: Dressing and sauces always on the side, stated not asked

hotel_breakfast.order: Veggie omelet or scrambled eggs, dry, fruit on the side instead of potatoes.
hotel_breakfast.marriott_note: Elite breakfast benefit is the easiest protein anchor of the trip, use it by default.

morning.summary: Hotel eggs alone get to ~19g. Add lounge protein on travel days to close the 35-40g floor.

fast_casual_order.script: Double [chicken/steak/salmon], salad base not rice, no cheese, no crema, salsa or vinaigrette on the side.
fast_casual_order.availability: Chipotle-format chains in all four cities, roughly 20 locations in central London.

midday.client_lunch_or_room_service: Same script as dinner. Grilled or roasted protein, vegetables instead of starch, sauce on the side.

grocery_deli.approach: Rotisserie or roast protein plus pre-cut vegetables, eaten cold if needed.
